options.option: Switch Pulse - drive a Switch item ON during TRIGGERED
MP3 Audio - play an audio file via an openHAB audio sink
Strobe - toggle a Switch on a pattern

parameter.name: targetItem
parameter.label: Target Item
parameter.description: The Switch item the driver writes (switchPulse and strobe).

parameter.name: claimDuringTriggered
parameter.label: Claim During Triggered
parameter.description: Re-assert the target state every reassertEverySeconds while TRIGGERED, fighting other rules.

parameter.name: testDurationSeconds
parameter.label: Test Duration (s)
parameter.description: How long the TEST channel runs the driver.

parameter.name: audioSink
parameter.label: Audio Sink
parameter.description: openHAB audio sink UID (mp3 driver only).

parameter.name: audioUrl
parameter.label: Audio URL/File
parameter.description: Audio file (relative to sounds/ folder) or URL (mp3 driver only).

parameter.name: strobePatternMs
parameter.label: Strobe Pattern
parameter.description: Comma-separated on,off milliseconds (strobe driver only). e.g. 500,500
